propositions: PydanticAIRunner.run() spans 408 lines (59% of runner.py), creating a maintainability and size pressure that prior callee extractions do not relieve because the method itself continues absorbing new work

ProviderSession is constructed at runner.py:301 but its try guard does not start until line 474, leaving lines 301-473 outside exception handling and leaking an open httpx.AsyncClient when code in that window raises

Three child extractions (interpret_failure, build_model_settings/build_usage_limits, and session context manager guard) must land as a coordinated stack to bring runner.py from 782 LOC under the 700-line headroom guard, since no single extraction achieves this alone

The per-file size gate does not constrain the per-method bloat because extracting a callee satisfies the file gate while the calling method continues growing, making method-level decomposition necessary to address the actual problem
